note: Samoa issues no national identity card yet: birth registration is its officially recognised legal identity, and the National Digital Identification System, which introduces a 10-digit identification number and a biometric database, is still being rolled out (SEAP digital ID overview).

sources.title: Institute on Statelessness and Inclusion / SEAP, Digital ID overview: Samoa
sources.said: The officially recognized legal identity in Samoa is birth registration, which provides an individual with a birth certificate. ... This framework will introduce a unique 10-digit identification number (SDIN) and create a national identity database which will store biometric information of applicants.
